title: The Shawshank Redemption
description: A banker sentenced to life in prison forms an unlikely friendship and quietly plans for freedom, finding hope and resilience amid corruption and cruelty.

title: The Godfather
description: The aging head of a powerful Italian-American crime family considers his successor as his youngest son is drawn into the violent world of organized crime.

title: The Dark Knight
description: Batman faces the Joker, a chaotic criminal who pushes Gotham City toward moral collapse and forces its heroes to confront difficult ethical choices.

title: Inception
description: A skilled thief who enters people's dreams is hired to plant an idea in a target's mind, leading to a layered mission where reality becomes uncertain.

title: Interstellar
description: As Earth becomes increasingly uninhabitable, a former pilot joins a space mission through a wormhole to search for a future home for humanity.

title: The Matrix
description: A computer programmer discovers that the world he knows is a simulated reality and joins a rebellion against the machines controlling humanity.

title: Jurassic Park
description: Scientists and visitors tour a theme park populated by genetically recreated dinosaurs, but a security failure turns the attraction into a fight for survival.

title: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring
description: A young hobbit and a diverse fellowship set out across a dangerous fantasy world to destroy a powerful ring before its dark master can reclaim it.

title: Harry Potter and the Sorcerer's Stone
description: An orphan discovers he is a wizard and begins studying at a magical school, where new friendships and a mystery reveal his connection to a dangerous past.

title: Gladiator
description: A betrayed Roman general is forced into slavery and becomes a gladiator, seeking justice against the emperor who destroyed his family and career.

title: Mad Max: Fury Road
description: In a brutal desert wasteland, a drifter joins a rebellious driver and a group of escapees in a high-speed struggle against a tyrannical warlord.

title: John Wick
description: A retired assassin returns to the criminal underworld after a personal tragedy, setting off a relentless conflict with dangerous figures from his past.

title: Mission: Impossible – Fallout
description: An elite secret agent and his team race to recover stolen nuclear material while navigating betrayals, international conspiracies, and high-risk stunts.

title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
description: A Brooklyn teenager gains spider-like powers and meets alternate-universe heroes who help him learn what it means to become a hero in a multiverse crisis.

title: Toy Story
description: A cowboy doll feels threatened when a high-tech action figure becomes a child's new favorite toy, prompting an adventure that tests their rivalry and friendship.

title: Finding Nemo
description: An anxious clownfish crosses the ocean to find his missing son, encountering unusual sea creatures and learning to balance caution with trust.

title: Inside Out
description: Inside the mind of a young girl, personified emotions struggle to guide her through a major life change and discover why sadness matters.

title: Coco
description: An aspiring young musician enters the Land of the Dead during a family celebration and uncovers the truth about his ancestors and the power of remembrance.

title: The Lion King
description: A young lion prince flees his kingdom after a family tragedy, then must confront his past and reclaim his place in the circle of life.

title: Shrek
description: A grumpy ogre sets out to rescue a princess to regain his swamp, but an unexpected friendship challenges his assumptions about appearances and love.

title: Titanic
description: A young artist and an upper-class passenger fall in love aboard a luxury ocean liner, as class divisions and a maritime disaster threaten their future.

title: Pride & Prejudice
description: A sharp-witted young woman navigates family expectations, social class, and her complicated feelings toward a wealthy, reserved gentleman in Regency England.

title: La La Land
description: An aspiring actress and a jazz musician fall in love while pursuing their creative ambitions in Los Angeles, forcing them to weigh romance against their dreams.

title: The Hangover
description: After a chaotic bachelor-party night in Las Vegas, three friends wake up with no memory of the evening and must retrace their steps to find the groom.

title: Groundhog Day
description: A cynical television weatherman becomes trapped reliving the same day, gradually changing his outlook as he tries to understand the strange loop.

title: Get Out
description: A young Black man visits his white girlfriend's family estate and notices unsettling behavior that leads him to uncover a disturbing secret.

title: A Quiet Place
description: A family struggles to survive in a world where sound-hunting creatures make even the smallest noise deadly, forcing them to communicate in silence.

title: The Conjuring
description: Paranormal investigators help a family living in a remote farmhouse where increasingly frightening events suggest a malevolent supernatural presence.

title: Knives Out
description: A celebrated mystery novelist dies after a family gathering, and a sharp detective investigates a house full of relatives with secrets and competing motives.

title: The Martian
description: An astronaut stranded alone on Mars uses science, ingenuity, and determination to survive while a team on Earth works to bring him home.

title: 3 Idiots
description: Three engineering students navigate academic pressure, friendship, family expectations, and the question of whether education should prioritize learning over grades.

title: Dangal
description: A former wrestler trains his daughters to compete in wrestling, challenging social expectations and helping them pursue sporting success.

title: Lagaan
description: A village in colonial India challenges British officers to a high-stakes cricket match to escape an oppressive tax burden.

title: Sholay
description: Two small-time criminals are hired by a retired police officer to capture a ruthless bandit terrorizing a village.

title: Dilwale Dulhania Le Jayenge
description: Two young Indians meet while traveling through Europe and fall in love, but must win over a traditional family before they can be together.

title: Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham
description: A wealthy family is divided when a son marries against his father's wishes, and years later his younger brother tries to reunite them.

title: Zindagi Na Milegi Dobara
description: Three longtime friends take a road trip through Spain, confronting their fears, relationships, and priorities before one friend's wedding.

title: Taare Zameen Par
description: A child who struggles at school because of undiagnosed dyslexia finds understanding and confidence through an art teacher who recognizes his potential.

title: Queen
description: After her fiancé cancels their wedding, a sheltered young woman travels alone on her planned honeymoon and discovers independence and confidence.

title: Andhadhun
description: A pianist pretending to be blind becomes entangled in a murder mystery, where deception and unexpected twists make it difficult to know whom to trust.

title: Drishyam
description: A devoted family man uses careful planning and his knowledge of films to protect his family after they become involved in a serious crime.

title: PK
description: An alien stranded on Earth asks unusual questions about human beliefs and religious practices, exposing contradictions while searching for a way home.

title: Bajrangi Bhaijaan
description: A kind-hearted Indian man helps a mute Pakistani girl who has become separated from her family and undertakes a journey to reunite them.

title: Chak De! India
description: A disgraced former hockey player coaches India's women's national team, helping players from different backgrounds build trust and compete for a championship.

title: Gully Boy
description: A young man from Mumbai's working-class neighborhoods pursues a career in rap music while confronting poverty, family pressure, and limited opportunities.

title: Barfi!
description: A cheerful deaf-and-mute young man forms meaningful relationships with two women, finding love and connection despite social expectations and misunderstandings.

title: Munna Bhai M.B.B.S.
description: A lovable local gangster pretends to be a medical student to fulfill his father's dream, but his compassionate approach challenges a rigid hospital culture.

title: Rang De Basanti
description: A British filmmaker casts young Indian friends in a documentary about freedom fighters, inspiring them to question corruption and take a stand.

title: Jab We Met
description: A heartbroken businessman meets a lively, talkative woman on a train, and their unexpected journey helps both reconsider love and their future.

title: Swades
description: An Indian-American scientist returns to his homeland to reconnect with his past and becomes motivated to help improve life in a rural village.

title: Kahaani
description: A pregnant woman arrives in Kolkata searching for her missing husband, uncovering a dangerous conspiracy as she follows clues through the crowded city.
